# `aitbc explorer blocks-by-address`

Get blocks containing transactions for a given address.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer blocks-by-address [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | yes | Blockchain address to fund. |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Number of blocks to return |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer blocks-by-address --address <address>
```
